_comment: Config for the fresh dataset-construction workflow (docs/dataset_workflow_plan.md). Block ranges are deliberately modest by default -- public RPC throughput is ~7-8 blocks/s single endpoint (see revision_v3/src/temporal/rpc_client.py). Widen via config, not code, once the pipeline is verified end to end.

ethereum._note: If start_block/end_block are null, the collector resolves end_block = latest, start_block = latest - lookback_blocks at run time and records the resolved values into the run manifest.
